## 4 Commands

Test Command: none
Start Command: `python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1`

files.README.md:
# xmdtest-site

Tiny static shop page used by the XMD verification-round test (task 26).

ledger.decision_summary: Inter / system sans-serif only. Sentence case everywhere: NO all-caps text — text-transform: uppercase is forbidden on every element.

The header holds the logo (left), the nav, and a theme toggle button at the right end: <button id="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme"> at least 44x44px that switches html[data-theme] between dark and light.
Mobile first: no horizontal scrolling at 375, 768 or 1280 px. Every block fits the viewport width; content max-width 1100px.
Dark default: background #0B0C10, text #E5E7EB, accent #F2F0EB. Light theme via html[data-theme=light].
